name: Advances in Casting Technology
description: The objective of the course is to understand the advances in casting technologies. The solidification behavior of metals, fluidity aspects, grain structure and related mechanical properties are analyzed. Sand casting: sand molding techniques, core sand and core fabrication. Other casting: permanent mold, pressure die casting, squeeze casting, centrifugal casting, continuous casting, stir casting, ultrasonic assisted stir casting. Defects and inspection. Gating system, risering system, casting design: metallurgical consideration, design consideration, economical consideration. Fluidity testing, application of CADCAM in foundry. Casting of complicated shapes: automotive components, casting of light alloys – aluminum, magnesium and titanium alloys. Aluminum, magnesium based composite casting.
